meanings.en: a person in charge of a military force or unit
meanings.exampleEn: The commander ordered his troops to advance at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Komutan birliklerine şafakta ilerlemelerini emretti.

meanings.en: to honour the memory of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: A monument was built to commemorate the soldiers who died in the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşta ölen askerleri anmak için bir anıt inşa edildi.

meanings.en: the buying and selling of goods and services
meanings.exampleEn: The internet has transformed global commerce.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternet küresel ticareti dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: a group of nations or states united by common interests
meanings.exampleEn: Many former British colonies are members of the Commonwealth.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski İngiliz sömürgelerinin çoğu Uluslar Topluluğu üyesidir.

meanings.en: willing or able to talk and share information
meanings.exampleEn: She is a communicative person who easily makes new friends.
meanings.exampleTr: O, kolayca yeni arkadaşlar edinen konuşkan bir insandır.

meanings.en: a group of people living in the same area or sharing common interests
meanings.exampleEn: The whole community came together to rebuild the school.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün topluluk okulu yeniden inşa etmek için bir araya geldi.

meanings.en: to travel regularly between home and work
meanings.exampleEn: She has to commute two hours every day to reach her office.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofisine ulaşmak için her gün iki saat yol gitmek zorunda.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of sympathy for others' suffering
meanings.exampleEn: He treated the homeless with great compassion.
meanings.exampleTr: Evsizlere büyük bir şefkatle davrandı.

meanings.en: feeling or showing sympathy for others
meanings.exampleEn: The nurse was kind and compassionate towards her patients.
meanings.exampleTr: Hemşire hastalarına karşı nazik ve şefkatliydi.

meanings.en: able to exist or work together without problems
meanings.exampleEn: This software is compatible with most operating systems.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yazılım çoğu işletim sistemiyle uyumludur.

meanings.en: to give something to make up for loss or damage
meanings.exampleEn: The company agreed to compensate the workers for their injuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket işçilerin yaralanmalarını tazmin etmeyi kabul etti.

meanings.en: money or something given to make up for loss or damage
meanings.exampleEn: She received compensation for the accident at work.
meanings.exampleTr: İş yerindeki kaza için tazminat aldı.

meanings.en: the ability to do something well
meanings.exampleEn: He demonstrated great competence in managing the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi yönetmede büyük bir yeterlik gösterdi.

meanings.en: to collect information and arrange it in a list or report
meanings.exampleEn: The researcher spent months compiling data for her thesis.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırmacı tezi için veri derlemekle aylar geçirdi.

meanings.en: the act of finishing something
meanings.exampleEn: The completion of the bridge took three years.
meanings.exampleTr: Köprünün tamamlanması üç yıl sürdü.

meanings.en: the natural colour and condition of the skin on a person's face
meanings.exampleEn: She has a fair complexion that burns easily in the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneşte kolayca yanan açık bir teni var.

meanings.en: the state of being complicated or having many parts
meanings.exampleEn: The complexity of the problem made it hard to solve.
meanings.exampleTr: Problemin karmaşıklığı onu çözmeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: one of the parts that make up a whole
meanings.exampleEn: Each component of the engine must be checked carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Motorun her bileşeni dikkatlice kontrol edilmelidir.

meanings.en: the ability to understand something
meanings.exampleEn: The test measures students' reading comprehension.
meanings.exampleTr: Test, öğrencilerin okuduğunu anlama becerisini ölçer.

meanings.en: including everything that is necessary
meanings.exampleEn: The book offers a comprehensive guide to the subject.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap, konuya dair kapsamlı bir rehber sunuyor.

meanings.en: a soft pad pressed onto part of the body to relieve pain or stop bleeding
meanings.exampleEn: The nurse applied a cold compress to reduce the swelling.
meanings.exampleTr: Hemşire şişliği azaltmak için soğuk bir kompres uyguladı.

meanings.en: the act of pressing something into a smaller space
meanings.exampleEn: Data compression reduces the size of large files.
meanings.exampleTr: Veri sıkıştırma, büyük dosyaların boyutunu azaltır.

meanings.en: required by a rule or law
meanings.exampleEn: Education is compulsory for all children up to the age of sixteen.
meanings.exampleTr: Eğitim, on altı yaşına kadar tüm çocuklar için zorunludur.

meanings.en: to calculate an amount or number
meanings.exampleEn: The software can compute the results in seconds.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılım sonuçları saniyeler içinde hesaplayabilir.

meanings.en: to hide something so it cannot be seen or known
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to conceal his disappointment from his friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayal kırıklığını arkadaşlarından gizlemeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: excessive pride in oneself
meanings.exampleEn: His conceit made it difficult for others to work with him.
meanings.exampleTr: Kibri, başkalarının onunla çalışmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: possible to imagine or believe
meanings.exampleEn: It is conceivable that prices will rise again next year.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatların gelecek yıl tekrar yükselmesi akla yatkındır.

meanings.en: to form an idea or plan in the mind
meanings.exampleEn: The architect conceived a bold design for the new museum.
meanings.exampleTr: Mimar, yeni müze için cesur bir tasarım tasarladı.

meanings.en: an idea or understanding of something
meanings.exampleEn: They had no clear conception of how difficult the task would be.
meanings.exampleTr: Görevin ne kadar zor olacağına dair net bir fikirleri yoktu.

meanings.en: something allowed or given up to end a disagreement
meanings.exampleEn: Both sides made concessions to reach an agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmaya varmak için her iki taraf da taviz verdi.

meanings.en: definite and based on facts, not abstract
meanings.exampleEn: We need concrete evidence before making a decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir karar vermeden önce somut kanıta ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: to express strong disapproval of something
meanings.exampleEn: World leaders condemned the violent attack.
meanings.exampleTr: Dünya liderleri şiddetli saldırıyı kınadı.

meanings.en: a person who directs an orchestra, or a material that carries electricity or heat
meanings.exampleEn: The conductor raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
meanings.exampleTr: Orkestra şefi değneğini kaldırdı ve orkestra çalmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a shape with a round base narrowing to a point at the top
meanings.exampleEn: The child held an ice cream cone in her hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk elinde bir dondurma külahı tutuyordu.

meanings.en: a formal meeting for discussion
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a speech at the international conference on climate change.
meanings.exampleTr: İklim değişikliği üzerine uluslararası konferansta bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: the activity of holding meetings between people in different places using technology
meanings.exampleEn: Video conferencing allows teams to meet without travelling.
meanings.exampleTr: Video konferans, ekiplerin seyahat etmeden buluşmasını sağlar.

meanings.en: to admit that you have done something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He finally confessed that he had broken the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda pencereyi kırdığını itiraf etti.

meanings.en: a statement admitting that you have done something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The suspect signed a full confession at the police station.
meanings.exampleTr: Şüpheli karakolda tam bir itiraf imzaladı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you feel sure of yourself
meanings.exampleEn: She answered the difficult questions confidently.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor soruları kendinden emin bir şekilde yanıtladı.

meanings.en: to keep someone or something within limits
meanings.exampleEn: The illness confined him to bed for a week.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık onu bir hafta boyunca yatağa hapsetti.

meanings.en: to face or deal with a difficult situation or person
meanings.exampleEn: She decided to confront her boss about the unfair decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Adil olmayan karar hakkında patronuyla yüzleşmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: a word that joins parts of a sentence, or a combination of events
meanings.exampleEn: The word 'and' is a common conjunction in English.
meanings.exampleTr: 'And' kelimesi İngilizcede yaygın bir bağlaçtır.

meanings.en: the act of taking control of a country or area by force
meanings.exampleEn: The Norman conquest of England took place in 1066.
meanings.exampleTr: İngiltere'nin Norman fethi 1066'da gerçekleşti.

meanings.en: the inner sense of what is right and wrong
meanings.exampleEn: His conscience would not let him lie to his parents.
meanings.exampleTr: Vicdanı, ailesine yalan söylemesine izin vermedi.

meanings.en: the state of being awake and aware of one's surroundings
meanings.exampleEn: He lost consciousness after the heavy blow to his head.
meanings.exampleTr: Kafasına aldığı sert darbeden sonra bilincini kaybetti.

meanings.en: permission for something to happen
meanings.exampleEn: The patient gave her consent before the operation.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta, ameliyattan önce rızasını verdi.

meanings.en: by a large amount or to a large degree
meanings.exampleEn: Prices have risen considerably over the past year.
meanings.exampleTr: Fiyatlar geçen yıl boyunca önemli ölçüde arttı.

meanings.en: always behaving or happening in the same way
meanings.exampleEn: Her work has been consistent throughout the year.
meanings.exampleTr: Çalışması yıl boyunca tutarlı olmuştur.

meanings.en: comfort received after a disappointment or loss
meanings.exampleEn: It was a consolation to know that her family supported her.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesinin onu desteklediğini bilmek bir teselliydi.

meanings.en: to comfort someone who is sad or disappointed
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to console her friend after the sad news.
meanings.exampleTr: Üzücü haberden sonra arkadaşını teselli etmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: happening all the time or not changing
meanings.exampleEn: The constant noise from the street kept me awake.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokaktan gelen sürekli gürültü beni uyanık tuttu.

meanings.en: to ask someone for advice or information
meanings.exampleEn: You should consult a doctor about your symptoms.
meanings.exampleTr: Belirtilerin hakkında bir doktora danışmalısın.

meanings.en: an expert who gives professional advice
meanings.exampleEn: The company hired a consultant to improve its marketing.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, pazarlamasını iyileştirmek için bir danışman tuttu.

meanings.en: to make something dirty or impure by adding harmful substances
meanings.exampleEn: Chemicals from the factory contaminated the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrikadan gelen kimyasallar nehri kirletti.

meanings.en: belonging to the present time
meanings.exampleEn: The gallery features contemporary art from young artists.
meanings.exampleTr: Galeri, genç sanatçıların çağdaş sanatını sergiliyor.

meanings.en: a feeling that someone or something is worthless
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at him with contempt after he lied.
meanings.exampleTr: Yalan söyledikten sonra ona küçümseyerek baktı.

meanings.en: happy and satisfied with what you have
meanings.exampleEn: She felt content with her simple but peaceful life.
meanings.exampleTr: Basit ama huzurlu yaşamından memnundu.

meanings.en: to say the opposite of what someone else has said
meanings.exampleEn: His later statement seemed to contradict his earlier one.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonraki ifadesi, önceki ifadesiyle çelişiyor gibiydi.

meanings.en: a difference between two statements or facts that cannot both be true
meanings.exampleEn: There is a contradiction between what he says and what he does.
meanings.exampleTr: Söyledikleri ile yaptıkları arasında bir çelişki var.

meanings.en: containing parts that are opposite and cannot both be true
meanings.exampleEn: The witnesses gave contradictory accounts of the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanıklar kazayla ilgili çelişkili ifadeler verdi.

meanings.en: a public disagreement about something
meanings.exampleEn: The new law caused considerable controversy among voters.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa, seçmenler arasında epey tartışmaya yol açtı.

meanings.en: in a way that is easy or suitable for one's needs
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel is conveniently located near the train station.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel, tren istasyonunun yakınında uygun bir konumda yer alıyor.

meanings.en: an accepted way of behaving, or a large formal meeting
meanings.exampleEn: It is a social convention to shake hands when meeting someone.
meanings.exampleTr: Biriyle tanışırken el sıkışmak toplumsal bir gelenektir.

meanings.en: following the usual or traditional way of doing things
meanings.exampleEn: They chose a conventional design for their new house.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni evleri için geleneksel bir tasarım seçtiler.

meanings.en: the opposite of a statement or fact
meanings.exampleEn: He believes hard work brings success, but the converse is not always true.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok çalışmanın başarı getirdiğine inanıyor, ama tersi her zaman doğru değil.

meanings.en: in an opposite way; from the other point of view
meanings.exampleEn: Some people love the cold; conversely, others cannot stand it.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı insanlar soğuğu sever; tersine, diğerleri ona dayanamaz.

meanings.en: the act of changing something into a different form
meanings.exampleEn: The conversion of the old factory into flats took two years.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski fabrikanın dairelere dönüştürülmesi iki yıl sürdü.

meanings.en: to change something into a different form or use
meanings.exampleEn: They plan to convert the garage into an office.
meanings.exampleTr: Garajı bir ofise dönüştürmeyi planlıyorlar.

meanings.en: completely certain that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: She was convinced that she had locked the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı kilitlediğine emindi.

meanings.en: the act of working together towards a common goal
meanings.exampleEn: The project succeeded thanks to the cooperation of the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje, tüm ekibin iş birliği sayesinde başarılı oldu.
